summary: Spec fidelity, dispatch.secret-scan.01-03: every other flow step of canon-0-39-secret-scan (F2-F6) has a @case:failure scenario; F1 has only @case:happy (.01, .03) and @case:edge (.02). The brief gives F1 its own failure path (one refused line fails the test, with sk-live-123456 and a digit-free long sk- run in the table). The tests do carry it (.01 asserts each plain line becomes a pack with a sha256 id and the scanner finds no span; a refusal panics naming the line), so the behavior is proved and .01-.03 are signed; only the scenario labels lack a failure case. Blast radius: none in code, only a reader who filters by @case.
